headings.usage: Use for H1, H2, H3 and high-level dashboard metrics to evoke legal authority and 'Old Money Tech' aesthetic.

body.usage: Use for all body text, tables, form inputs, and labels. Provides a sterile, precise, highly legible contrast to the serif headings.

mono.usage: Use for IDs, document numbers, timestamps, and fee amounts to ensure vertical alignment of digits.

primary.description: Deep Legal Navy - use for sidebar backgrounds, primary buttons, and active states. Represents trust and authority.

background.description: Crisp white for main content areas to mimic physical paper. Subtle blue-tinted grey for page backgrounds.

accent.description: Subtle muted gold for special badges, premium indicators, or highlight borders.

borders.description: Keep border radii minimal (2px-4px) to maintain a rigid, authoritative structure rather than playful curves. Use 1px solid borders for definition.

surfaces.cards: Flat solid background with 1px border. No heavy drop shadows by default.
surfaces.signature_pad: bg-[#FDFDFD] border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-sm relative. Add a subtle 'X _____' line at the bottom.

layouts.general: Sidebar navigation + Main content area. The sidebar should be Deep Navy (#0A192F) with white text. Top header is crisp white with a 1px bottom border.
layouts.dashboard: Bento Grid Protocol (Mode B: High Density). Strict grid hierarchy, dense spacing.
layouts.forms: 2-column grid for journal entries. Group fields logically: Signer Information, Document Details, Notarization Type, Fees.
layouts.tables: Dense rows, left-aligned data, right-aligned monetary values. Zebra striping or subtle border-bottom for rows.

grids.dashboard_charts: col-span-1 lg:col-span-3 for main chart, col-span-1 for recent activity feed

motion.transitions: Fast and precise. transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out.
motion.hover_states: Buttons subtly lift (-translate-y-[1px]) and gain a slightly darker hue or increased shadow.
motion.lists: Staggered fade-in for journal entry lists.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against the navy background is pure white or very light gray. Use muted colors carefully to maintain 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.test_ids: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='signature-canvas').

media.signature: The signature pad must be an HTML Canvas element, configured to handle touch and mouse events smoothly, outputting a base64 image string.

avatar_placeholder.description: Professional avatar for the notary public profile/settings.

auth_background.description: Legal document with a pen, used as the background or side panel image for the Login/Register screen.

components_to_use: Shadcn Form & React Hook Form (Create/Edit journal)
Shadcn Dialog (Modals for quick viewing entries)
React Signature Canvas (or custom HTML5 canvas for digital signature)
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement JWT Auth flow with a dedicated Login/Register page.
Build a robust Dashboard: Use Recharts for monthly revenue and stats. Layout using High Density Bento grid.
Journal Entries system: Needs list view with search/filter, and a comprehensive Create/Edit form.
Form fields must include: Date/Time, Notarization Type (Acknowledgment, Jurat, etc.), Signer Name, Address, ID Type/Number, Document Description, Fee, and Digital Signature.
Implement a Canvas-based Signature Pad component that captures the signature and saves it (e.g., as base64).
Clients/Signers database: A separate page listing past signers, searchable.
Document Types management: A simple settings area to add/remove common document types.
PDF Export: Implement functionality (e.g., using jspdf or standard print styling) to export journal logs.
Use Playfair Display for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body. Do NOT use Inter for headings.
Theme: primarily Light Mode, using Deep Navy (#0A192F) as the brand/primary color. Avoid heavy gradients.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles, here specifically sharp or slightly rounded corners suitable for legal software.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use generous spacing. Cramped designs look cheap. Ensure tables have adequate cell padding.
